purpose: Reference-inspired cart, wishlist, and checkout review surfaces rendered with backend-owned product data and browser-owned Phase 1 cart/wishlist IDs.
businessRules: Cart and wishlist browser state may store only product IDs and quantities.
Product names, SKU, prices, categories, badges, and image URLs must come from SHRESTA-BE storefront product responses.
Cart viewing, wishlist viewing, and checkout review are public exploration flows.
Proceed To Checkout requires login; authenticated clicks create or reuse a backend 15-minute checkout order ID for the exact current cart.
Login is also required when the customer clicks Place Order / confirm-and-pay.
The login-required dialog must offer Continue Shopping and Login actions.
Stored checkout draft metadata must be cleared when the browser cart changes, and final confirm must refuse placement when the draft is missing, expired, or cart-signature mismatched.
When the HTTP-only customer session cookie validates through /api/customer-profile, checkout may call /api/customer-orders at the final review step.
Order draft creation must forward an Idempotency-Key to /api/customer-orders/draft; final order placement must forward draftOrderId and an Idempotency-Key to /api/customer-orders.
Order placement must submit only draftOrderId, product IDs/quantities, and customer-entered fulfillment data, and trust backend totals/statuses/item snapshots.
The browser cart is cleared only after SHRESTA-BE successfully persists and returns an order.
The browser cart must remain unchanged when navigating to login and returning to checkout.
Displayed pre-submit totals are customer-facing estimates; post-submit totals come from the backend order response.

Checkout delivery choices must preserve SHRESTA quick-commerce language and price-speed hierarchy: scheduled 2-4 hr, priority 60-90 min, and rapid 30-60 min slots instead of multi-day shipping timelines.
Checkout delivery inputs use regex-backed validation, Indian PIN auto-fill for known local/UAT PINs, and optional landmark handling.
Checkout detail fields surface inline regex validation after blur using the same validators as the final submit gate.
The checkout mobile field uses a dedicated segmented phone control with an India +91 country-code pill, divider, and separate numeric input so typed digits never overlap the prefix.

Checkout icons must remain semantic and distinct: details uses ShieldCheck, delivery uses Truck, payment uses CreditCard, review uses CheckCircle2, address types use Home/Building2/MapPin, and item summary uses Package.
Customer-visible cart and checkout text must use SHRESTA/customer language and must not mention backend, DB, snapshots, events, API, or other implementation details.
